referents.why: 'The glory of Him' (third masculine singular): the nearest agreeing candidate is w5, God.
Interrogative 'why' (neuter singular) asks the question; refers to no candidate.
'Also I' (first singular) is the objector's voice in the question 'why am I still judged?'; not a candidate.
referents.category: first person in a diatribe question

links.why: Reversed: the question 'why am I still judged?' (cl0) is what the condition governs.
The if-clause cl1 ('if my lie accentuates God's truthfulness') conditions the question cl0.
No and joins the two clauses; the kai inside cl0 is 'also I', not a link to cl1.

groups.why: The condition conditions the question cl0.

cant_tell.why: Mid-verse only; a verse-opening 'but' has no host in its own verse.
